code_provenance.limitation: The saved recovery version computes software_sha256 by reading its source path at status-writing time. A later on-disk edit can change that field without changing code already loaded in the running process. Current source and final reported hash must not be asserted as the inflight executed source version. Receipt/raw-byte verification is independent of this uncertainty.

limitations: Byte uniqueness does not establish uniqueness of decoded numerical CSI arrays.
Full MAT decoding, timestamp/CSI numerical QA, storage-order adapter and model/config freeze are separate gates.
